scope_note: Recommendations are internal product-taxonomy judgments based on linked official sources, not claims that a vendor has no return policy or legal entitlement. No candidate is admitted and no rulebook is promoted by this packet.
approval_instructions: Assign a named maintainer. Resolve each scoped-product blocker, approve or reject the recommendation, and record reviewed_by, reviewed_at_utc, scope and evidence URLs. Approval of applicability does not approve deterministic vendor rules.

reviews.scope: Direct ClickUp paid workspace subscription only. Not merchandise, marketplace purchases or a general consumer-return rule.
reviews.finding: The official page describes role-based software subscription fees and an initial paid-plan refund guarantee. This supports a subscription/refund scope, not a physical-goods return decision.
admission_blockers: Confirm the individual-plan interpretation of a workspace/team product before admission.
Keep initial subscription purchase distinct from renewals.

reviews.scope: Direct Miro Starter or Business subscription only. Excludes marketplace apps and customer transactions.
reviews.finding: The official article covers administrative billing actions, subscription cancellation and support review of incorrect charges. It does not establish a blanket merchandise or digital-product return entitlement.
admission_blockers: Do not map Starter/Business team administration onto US individual plans without an explicit scope decision.
Do not infer a deterministic refund entitlement from instructions to contact support.

reviews.scope: Direct monday.com software account subscription only. Excludes marketplace apps, separately negotiated terms and downstream customer sales.
reviews.finding: The official policy distinguishes first-time purchases, renewed accounts and seat auto-upgrades. It describes subscription refunds and cancellation, not a separate physical-return operation.
admission_blockers: Initial purchase versus renewal and notice periods need distinct facts.
Account administrator authority and team-plan scope are not captured by the current individual-plan label.

reviews.scope: Direct Typeform paid subscription only. Excludes respondent payments collected through forms and third-party products.
reviews.finding: The official article discusses downgrading paid features, prepaid billing periods and refunds for canceled plans. A separate goods-return decision is not established for this scoped subscription.
admission_blockers: Do not treat the absence of a goods-return operation as a denial of subscription refund rights.
Form respondent purchases are a different merchant relationship.

reviews.scope: Direct Vimeo platform subscription only. Excludes Vimeo OTT creator sales, viewer purchases, add-ons and app-store billing.
reviews.finding: The official article separates monthly and annual initial subscriptions, app-store purchases and add-ons. Its subject is platform subscription refunds, not a generic return right across Vimeo products.
admission_blockers: Billing cadence and purchase channel must be represented before a deterministic refund rule.
Do not include OTT viewers or creator sales under the platform subscription policy.

reviews.scope: Membership subscription, digital-product purchase and one-to-one session must be separate scopes.
reviews.finding: The official policy expressly addresses non-returnable digital products separately from membership refunds and session disputes. A vendor-wide 'return not applicable' approval would erase a real product distinction.
admission_blockers: Split membership, digital products and sessions before signing off applicability.
Keep trials, renewals, usage conditions, app-store billing and regional exceptions distinct.

reviews.scope: Creator's direct Thinkific platform subscription only. Never substitute this for a learner's purchase from a course creator.
reviews.finding: The tracked refund source is a 2026 pricing-change article. It discusses cancellation and jurisdiction-dependent annual-term refunds but is not sufficient evidence for a general return or refund policy.
admission_blockers: Review broad platform billing terms before approving policy scope.
Retain the learner-versus-platform customer boundary and jurisdiction conditions.
